name: @@job@@
notes: The splat-only face swap of one recorded film (dancecap.film_faceswap swap + verify) on a Runpod GPU, made by `python -m dancecap.film_faceswap pod`, which fills this template (its tokens; the time limits follow the frame count) and runs it with `python -m dancecap remote run --jobs <job.json> --max-cost X`.

Only the VIDEO stream of the recording leaves the PC (a stream copy, the same coded bits): the recordings carry the class voices ('PRIVATE RENDER ... Local only; no upload'), so the audio never goes up; the wrapper refuses a bundle with any audio file or a video with an audio stream, and puts the recording's own audio back locally (stream copy, md5-checked).

Also shipped: the recorder's face sidecar, the two headshots, face_points_canonical.json and a `git archive` of the pinned FaceFusion v4 commit (~0.2 MB). FaceFusion's models (~1.5 GB) are fetched on the pod from FaceFusion's own hosts and checked against the local copies' crc32; onnxruntime-gpu runs on the CUDAExecutionProvider or the job stops (install.sh check, film_faceswap's session check).
